en.headline: Two arrested at HSBC headquarters over suspected false documents for accounts
en.dek: A 52-year-old man and a 53-year-old woman were detained on Tuesday afternoon after bank staff reported them at the Central building.
body: Police arrested a 52-year-old man and a 53-year-old woman at HSBC's headquarters in Central on Tuesday afternoon on suspicion of using false instruments.

Officers received a report from bank staff around 3pm at the HSBC Main Building on Queen's Road Central. After a preliminary investigation, they arrested the man, surnamed Ying, and the woman, surnamed Kam.
The pair are being detained. The case has been passed to the Central district crime investigation team.
Using a false instrument carries a maximum penalty of 14 years' imprisonment on conviction. Police continue to investigate.

zh.headline: 中環滙豐總行兩人涉用假文件開戶被捕
zh.dek: 52歲男子及53歲女子周二下午在皇后大道中滙豐總行被職員舉報後，涉嫌行使虛假文書被警方拘捕。
body: 警方周二下午在中環滙豐銀行總部拘捕一名52歲男子及一名53歲女子，涉嫌使用虛假文書。
警方於下午約3時接獲銀行職員報案，指皇后大道中滙豐總行大樓有人出示懷疑虛假文件。經初步調查後，拘捕姓邢的男子及姓金的女子。
兩人現正被扣留，案件交由中區警區刑事調查隊跟進。
根據法例，行使虛假文書一經定罪，最高可判監禁14年。警方正繼續調查。
